title: Publishing a primary Story generates its translations just in time
description:
As an editor, I want publishing a Story to generate, check and publish its translation in every enabled language by a defined procedure, so translations appear without anyone assembling them.

Design (Ryan's decisions 3 and 8): the translation procedure is data (guideline document kind translation-procedure, first consumer of guidelines-as-data P1): collect, translate changed blocks, rule checks, bilingual judge, target-language Humanus, repair or hold, render and publish, notify. Each step is a sub-task on the localization with its measured cost. Trigger is the publication setting translation.trigger (published now, approved later), written as a durable desired-state record keyed languageGroupId#language where announce_published runs (no stream on Item; a failed write fails loudly). Newer publishes overwrite the desired state; stale jobs are dropped; translation writes never enqueue translation. A new primary version shows a quiet 'updating' line on each localization until its re-translation publishes (decision 4). Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.

Feature: Just-in-time translations

Scenario: Publishing generates every enabled language
  Given Spanish and Chinese are enabled for a site
  When an English Story is published
  Then one Spanish and one Chinese job are queued and each runs the translation procedure to publish

Scenario: Rapid republishing is translated once
  Given an English Story is published three times within a minute
  When the Spanish worker runs
  Then it translates only the newest version

Scenario: A correction to the original
  Given a published Spanish localization
  When a corrected English version is published
  Then the Spanish page shows a quiet updating line that does not look like an error
  And the line disappears when the re-translated Spanish version is published

Scenario: The trigger is a setting
  Given a publication whose translation trigger is published
  When an English Story is approved but not yet published
  Then no translation runs

comments.text: FYI from the multi-tenant work (PR #1501, merged to develop 2026-11-13): LocalizationRequest is now in a new optional model group, `localization`, in OPTIONAL_MODEL_GROUPS (amplify/data/schema.ts). The listing indexes plus LocalizationRequest had taken a brand-new site's bootstrap-stage synth to 2,001 resources, over the 2,000 budget that scripts/test-bootstrap-stage.ts enforces (CloudFormation fails at 2,500 per operation); LocalizationRequest qualifies because nothing relates to it and no custom operation returns it. What it means: existing sites are unaffected (the group is only left out when a site sets PAPYRUS_BOOTSTRAP_STAGE=1 or lists it in excludeModelGroups). A brand-new site's FIRST deploy (bootstrap stage) has no LocalizationRequest table or API, so translation requests cannot be recorded until its second, normal deploy adds the model; nothing should rely on that model during the bootstrap deploy. If a future change makes another model relate to LocalizationRequest or a custom operation return it, it must leave the optional group (the group rule in schema.ts). Headroom is now 1,970 of 2,000. Also: Item's tenantId listing index moved to PPY-e958b5 because this release already gives Item listItemsByLanguageGroupAndLanguage (one new index per table per release).
